name: remote-browser
description: Run Chromium remotely and rebuild its pages as a scriptless interactive mirror
author: mystxcal

scripts.test: bash scripts/limited-run.sh bash -c 'pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 --if-present run test && pnpm run test:deployment'
scripts.test:deployment: bash scripts/limited-run.sh node --test deploy/timezone.test.mjs deploy/browser-policies.test.mjs deploy/egress-proxy.test.mjs deploy/fetch-xray.test.mjs deploy/cpa-migration.test.mjs deploy/cpa-broker.test.mjs deploy/profile-broker.test.mjs scripts/probe-session.test.mjs scripts/rrweb-patches.test.mjs
scripts.test:profiles-webkit: bash scripts/limited-run.sh env PROFILE_PICKER_BROWSER=webkit node scripts/profile-picker-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:live-tree-accept: bash scripts/limited-run.sh pnpm -F @mirror/gateway exec tsx src/hub/live-tree.accept.ts
scripts.smoke:cpa-tenancy: bash scripts/limited-run.sh env CPA_TENANCY_SMOKE=1 node scripts/cpa-tenancy-smoke.mjs
scripts.smoke:profile-egress: bash scripts/limited-run.sh env PROFILE_EGRESS_SMOKE=1 node scripts/profile-egress-smoke.mjs
scripts.ci: bash scripts/limited-run.sh bash -c 'node scripts/check-rrweb-versions.mjs && pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:rtc-media && pnpm run test:browser-lifecycle && pnpm run format:check'
